description: Firmware dialect changes preserve deposited paths while emitting the configured acceleration and pressure advance commands.

mutants.test_filter: GCode firmware flavor changes command dialect without changing deposited path
mutants.description: Marlin 2 uses M204 P for acceleration; dropping its branch emits the Marlin M204 S dialect.

mutants.test_filter: GCode firmware flavor changes command dialect without changing deposited path
mutants.description: Klipper pressure advance uses SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE rather than M900.
